hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details, Gorges State Park site 020 'Campsite Electric' ('Water Hookup: Y', 'Sewer Hookup: Y', 'Electricity Hookup: 20, 30, 50'), and the site list showing all 14 'Campsite Electric' sites with 'Water Hookup'; ncparks.gov camping page heading 'Tent, Trailer, and RV Camping - Some Full Hookups', read 2026-10-22

values.note: 14 full-hookup sites (017-030) with 50-ft paved back-in driveways; 16 non-electric sites (001-016) with 20-ft back-in driveways, too short for a 23-ft rig. Five camper cabins in the same campground.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica site list, loop 'Family Campground' (14 'Campsite Electric' '50 Back-In', 16 'Campsite Non-Electric' '20 Back-In') + site 020 details ('Driveway Length: 50', 'Max Vehicle Length: 50', 'Driveway Surface: Paved'); ncparks.gov camping page ('five camper cabins located in the family campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: campsites (electric and non-electric) 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival. The park gate is locked daily at posted closing hours (general park hours 7am-9pm); no vehicle access after closing except in an emergency.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/gorges-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552865 (Booking Window; 'Business Rules for Holiday Weekends'; alert 'General Park Hours: 7am to 9pm') + ncparks.gov camping page ('Park gate is locked daily at posted closing hours'), read 2026-10-22

note: NC State Parks, Grassy Ridge area near Sapphire on the Blue Ridge escarpment. Family campground with tent sites and five camper cabins; bathhouse. Bear-active park: food and scented items go in the bear-proof box at the site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50-ft max (14 paved 50-ft back-in full-hookup sites), ReserveAmerica booking. Added 50-amp/water/sewer at the electric sites, 30 sites (16 non-electric with 20-ft pads), year-round, 6-month window with same-day booking, the holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days, and the nightly gate lock. Fees ($30 non-electric / $45 full hookup incl. $3/night reservation fee; RA table $27/$42 for 2026) stand but see the base-rate flag. The Isaias closure covers only backcountry campsites and Chestnut Mountain Road. Not stated: showers, dump station, max stay.

Base rate: fees.nightly_low $30 is the non-electric price, but every non-electric site has a 20-ft back-in driveway (RA site list), which a 23-ft rig does not fit; the cheapest site EKKO fits is a full-hookup site at $42 + $3/night reservation fee = $45. Fees have a hand-checked provenance (price research 2026-10-12), so not overwritten here.
